notes.title: Fractal Abyss Update!
notes.content:
Hello players! 

Finally, I've finished with random levels feature. There is one new map available after the update called "Fractal Abyss". This map has following features:
[olist]
It comes in 3 sizes - small, medium and big

This map consist of random rooms wielded together

Generators spawn randomly within rooms and look different compared to other maps

Minimap shows staircases for better orientation
[/olist]
I've also introduced some optimization tweaks in the patch.


Honestly, I'm not sure what I want to do next, as the game didn't meet certain sales goals and people don't write much what they like and not like within the community hub, so I'm at the crossroads.



If you have any suggestions or feedback, please feel free to post it to the community hub!

notes.title: Difficulty Tuning Continued
notes.content:
I see that there're still some confusing moments and bugs in the game, so I've tried to fix that.

1. Monster can now only interact with objects that are in the same room as the monster. (Except the practice room, because it's a special safe map)
2. Temperature fluctuations should be easier to spot now.
3. Hive's "many" interactions ability within hunt alarm proximity will now try to interact with at least 4 items.
4. Quantum entanglement delay to appear decreased from 120 seconds to 10 seconds. So, now you can be sure that monster was there recently, not 2 minutes ago.
5. Buffed Oxygenic "Silent Steps" corruption ability from muffling monster steps by 30% to 70%
6. Teleportation corruption ability should now correctly reset monster state if he's chasing corrupted player.
7. Valves "no-smoke" mode threshold increased x2.0, fixed some places where rotation speed was old and slow.
8. "Generators are broken" sound will not play when repaired now.
9. Fixed other minor bugs.

If you have any suggestions or feedback, please feel free to post it to the community hub!

notes.title: Game Difficulty Overhaul
notes.content:
Game Difficulty Overhaul
So, looks like the game in current state is too hostile for new players. To address these issues I've made a massive overhaul over most aspects of the game.

Patch notes:
0. New players start the game with $2000. All current players receive a $2000 bonus.
1. Oxygen valves leakage was too unfriendly for most players. Monster interactions with valves will not affect oxygen in the room anymore. Now only broken oxygen generator and rooms without oxygen by design (open space room on Solveig for example) can cause asphyxiation. Oxygen generators now have a light indicator to better see when it's off or on.
2. Head traps now have limited duration - 45 seconds.
3. Temperature repair system has been simplified. You no longer need 2 people or camera in front of the temperature monitor to fix the temperature. All temperature monitors are now replaced with a console that allows 1 player to fix it on the spot. Temperature monsters now show the evidence more often. Chance to break temperature generator on round start has been decreased from 50% to 33%.
4. Valves rotation speed is increased x2.0.
5. Biomaterials to look for Low-carbon evidence have spawn rate increased by 30%. Now you need only 2 biomaterials to check for the evidence.
6. Random items spawn rate is increased by 30%.
7. Radiation in rooms have been simplified. Before, some rooms had high radiation by default. Now, all rooms have low radiation by default. Radioactive monsters now show the evidence more frequently.
8. All generators status panel has been introduced to check them from the ship. When any generator is broken you're getting an announcement within the ship. 
9. Quantum Entanglement area is doubled. Particles spawn rate is increased by 75%.
10. Stimpack now also gives you a speed boost of 15% for 5 seconds!
11. Journal hints are now shown when mouse cursor is over the button.
12. Night Vision battery capacity has been increased x2.0 to 45 seconds.
13. Quantum Lamp now works for 6 minutes instead of 3 minutes.
14. Monster activity monitor has been added to the ship.
15. Hunt cooldown for shy and neutral (non-agressive) monsters have been increased by approximately 25%.
16. Social monsters cooldown to answer to all types of voice interactions has been decreased by 20%.
17. Amount of traps on normal and hard difficulties have been decreased by 30%.

If you have any feedback, suggestions or questions please post them in the Community Hub!

notes.title: Practice Room map and difficulty fixes
notes.content:
1. Flashlight power has increased x2 - game is too dark sometimes, so flashlight fix should help with it.
2. Practice Room Map - a new very easy map has been added, where you can investigate the monster and test stuff. All equipment is provided on the map. You can still die there theoretically, but you won't lose any items if you have taken any.
3. Head traps and floor traps no longer spawn on Easy difficulty on all maps

notes.title: Tutorial Revamp Patch
notes.content:
As previous tutorial had some backtracking issues I've revamped it totally and added a feature to teleport between tutorial rooms by pressing F1. Hope it works better!

notes.title: Release and small hotfix
notes.content:
Hello!
Finally, Deep Dark Space has released, thanks to everyone who's playing the game!
As a small post release hotfix I've increased speed of gravity waves by ~x2.5, so it should be much easier to recognize now.
If you have any questions, suggestions etc don't hesitate to post it on the Steam Community Hub.

notes.title: Deep Dark Space release on 18th of April
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that Deep Dark Space will release on 18th of April 2025.
There are 24 monsters and 7 maps ready for investigation.
I've introduced 4 traitor types that can offer unique gameplay to trick your teammates misleading the investigation.
Monster can hear your in-game conversations and acts accordingly.
One of the monster visual types can steal your voice and use it against your team.
Game is translated to 6 languages.

What will be added soon after release:
Procedural levels are shifted to after release date. This feature is bigger than I've anticipated and needs more polish.

Development of DDS was a long journey with it's ups and downs, but finally release is soon. I want to thank all people who have wishlisted the game, helped testing it and expressed their opinion on the steam community hub.

notes.title: January Devlog
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I have some news to share:

1. I've finished new map - Infernum, it looks and feels quite different than other levels in the game, which is good.
2. Localization is complete and now I polish everything related to that. Here's a list of languages that would be available on release (Demo will still only have English and Russian for a while):
English,
German,
French,
Spanish,
Portuguese-Brazil,
Russian
3. Insanity system is intact and working, I'm tuning it, but I think it works fine and adds some funny situations to the game.
4. Game is out of early access state. I've been thinking about it for a while and I've decided to do a full release. Game has 24 different monsters, 6 maps and is very playable at the moment, so I'd qualify it as a non early access title. Release date is still somewhere in 2025, hopefully in Q1.
5. Right now I'm working on procedurally generated levels. They'll be lil bit different than usual levels mechanics wise, but I think it will add tremendous amount of replayability to the game.

That's it, thanks for reading, take care, please add the game to your wishlists and share with friends!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2541520/Deep_Dark_Space/

notes.title: December Devlog
notes.content:
I've decided to share things I'm working on right now:
1. Insanity System - when your mental health is low enough you start to see funny and scary stuff. I don't want to make it irritating, so no acid colors etc.
2. Infernum - new map - a small/middle sized station based on a volcanic lava planet. Unlike other maps this one is a hybrid between usual planet station and a cave system. I also plan to add some unique features to this map - for example a hole you can fall through, but can not come back same way.
3. Smoke grenade - new prop, that is currently can only be found during mission on-site, and can not be purchased.
4. Added few new screamers.
5. Polishing and fixing bugs.

If you have any suggestions etc - please feel free to post in a steam community hub.
Thank you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2541520/Deep_Dark_Space

notes.title: July and August updates:
notes.content:
1. Introduced map system that will allow easier navigation. It looks like a vertical slice of a floor with most objects visible and most important ones like generators are labeled with icons. You can also see other players on the map, so you can guide them through.

2. Corruption player now has 4 sub-types each with 4 unique abilities! I think it will diversify gameplay for both corrupted and usual players.

3. Monster chance to change it's favorite room is generally more rare now.

4. Added mouse sensitivity to options.

5. I continue to work on several maps at once.

So, what's next? I think about doing another round of demo version somewhere in September on a new map. Also, I want to introduce more different props that will diversify and deepen gameplay possibilities.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2541520/Deep_Dark_Space/

notes.title: Thanks for playing Demo!
notes.content:
For now, I've deactivated the Demo until next festivals. Thanks for everyone who've played it and especially to those who left feedback. After analyzing your feedback I understood following:

1. Easy difficulty is not that easy -> monster made too many interactions on easy difficulty which lead your team to constantly turn on/off something instead of checking for clues. I've reduced monster interactions multipliers on easy difficulty and slightly reduced chances to turn off generators.

2. Now it will be possible to tune if monster will stop the hunt or reduce hunt time after killing someone. It is already implemented on easy and medium difficulties.

3. Currently I'm working on a system that will allow players have easier time navigating through maps. I'm leaning to make a level map, but also considering making signs or lines to ease on-site navigation.

4. I'll add mouse sensitivity to game control options.

If you have more feedback please don't hesitate and post it on steam community hub! Thank you!
